newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse rallies in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse rallies in thin trade.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange rallied on Friday in thin trade buoyed by interest in dominant share Ashanti Goldfields Company, its market report showed.
The All-Share Index rose 1.32 points to end the week higher at 369.28 points from Wednesday's 367.96. The Index fell 0.20 points after rising 0.05 points on Monday.
Ashanti (+500 cedis to 26,500 cedis) was by far the largest of four risers. Dealers attributed the rise to a rally in world gold prices earlier in the week. There were no fallers.
Volume was up at 44,240 shares traded compared to 17,070 on Wednesday and Monday's 13,990. Offers totalled 1,003,720 shares compared to demand of 643,640.
